  <h1>The Trifold brief</h1>
  <p class="lede">Three sides of every dollar. Pick the path that fits you; each one is its own short deck, and you can switch paths from any slide.</p>

  <h2 id="paths-heading">I'm an…</h2>
  <ul class="picker" aria-labelledby="paths-heading">
    <li>
      <a href="/investors/">
        <span class="who">Investor</span>
        <span class="covers">The market and first wedge, business model and plans, illustrative financials (assumptions, not forecasts), the moat, go-to-market, risks and the ask.</span>
        <span class="time">19 slides · about 20 minutes</span>
      </a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a href="/firms/">
        <span class="who">Accounting firm or bookkeeper</span>
        <span class="covers">Provable books from your seat, the firm program (Listed, Practice, Practice Pro), what you earn from your own markup, and the Idaho and Utah rules on paying accountants.</span>
        <span class="time">14 slides · about 15 minutes</span>
      </a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a href="/schools/">
        <span class="who">School</span>
        <span class="covers">What families will get, the price ladder and what a school would pay, free self-hosting or hosted Trifold, and why your data stays yours.</span>
        <span class="time">13 slides · about 12 minutes</span>
      </a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a href="/partners/">
        <span class="who">Partner: network, co-op, affiliate or vertical software</span>
        <span class="covers">Affiliate tiers, organization affiliates instead of a downline, the anti-MLM rules, the Witness API, and a proposal for implementers.</span>
        <span class="time">16 slides · about 15 minutes</span>
      </a>
    </li>
  </ul>

  <a class="overview" href="/overview/">
    <span class="who">The 5-minute overview</span>
    <span class="covers">The problem, how it works, signed receipts and the open verifier, prices, the first market, and what is built versus next.</span>
    <span class="time">9 slides · about 5 minutes</span>
  </a>

  <p class="howto">In a deck: arrow keys or space to move, Esc for an overview of all slides, M for the slide menu. Each deck has a "Print or save as PDF" link.</p>
